programme.title: IP MAN 1 [English Dub]
programme.desc: A semi-biographical account of Yip Man, the first martial arts master to teach the Chinese martial art of Wing Chun. The film focuses on events surrounding Ip that took place in the city of Foshan between the 1930s to 1940s during the Second Sino-Japanese War. Directed by Wilson Yip, the film stars Donnie Yen in the lead role, and features fight choreography by Sammo Hung.

programme.title: IP MAN 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Having defeated the best fighters of the Imperial Japanese army in occupied Shanghai, Ip Man and his family settle in post-war Hong Kong. Struggling to make a living, Master Ip opens a kung fu school to bring his celebrated art of Wing Chun to the troubled youth of Hong Kong. His growing reputation soon brings challenges from powerful enemies, including pre-eminent Hung Gar master, Hung Quan.

programme.title: Escape from the 21st Century [English Dub]
programme.desc: The story follows three friends who discover they have the power to travel back and forth 20 years with a sneeze. However, the future is not as good as they hoped, and they need to take on the responsibility of saving the world.

programme.title: HELTER SKELTER [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Top star Lilico undergoes multiple cosmetic surgeries to her entire body. As her surgeries show side effect.

programme.title: The Getaway [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Three girls are abducted and taken to a remote island. They're held captive by three brothers raised in isolation by their grandmother. The girls are forced to become the brothers' mates and desperately attempt to escape their captors.

programme.title: The Goblin [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Doo-hyeon, who goes by the name the ''Goblin'', goes to prison for taking the fall for Yeong-min who killed their boss. Released after 10 years, Doo-hyeon had been living a normal life, until he found out Yeong-min had been taking advantage of his name. Yeong-min goes so far as to kidnap Doo-hyeon's daughter to keep his mouth shut. Enraged, Doo-hyeon seeks revenge and announces the return of the real ''Goblin''.

programme.title: Upstream [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Gao Zhilei's impulsive decision to become a stay-at-home husband leads to unforeseen challenges. As life takes a reverse turn, he's forced to face responsibilities as the family's breadwinner, ultimately finding himself and starting anew.

programme.title: The White Storm 2: Drug Lords [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: There is an iron rule in the Ching Hing Gang: No drug dealing. The gang leader, Yu Nam, has two right-hand men. One chooses to live in the bright world, while one is in the black. 15 yeas later, what will happen when they reunion?

programme.title: High Forces [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Distanced from his family after a car accident takes the sight of his daughter, a father must use his professional bodyguard training when a flight they're on is overtaken by armed hijackers. A taut puzzle of deception unravels when the hijackers' motivations are revealed and the father must rescue not only his daughter and wife, but all those aboard.

programme.title: Tazza: The Hidden Card [English Dub]
programme.desc: Dae-gil, a young man with natural born talents in gambling, makes a dazzling debut as a gambler and gets reunited with his first love, Mi-na. However, Dae-gil soon becomes the scapegoat of betrayal and conspiracy and is forced to be on the run. Dae-gil plans to get revenge and prepares for one big, fated game for Mi-na who has been helping him every step of the way.

programme.title: 200 Pounds Beauty [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Han-na is a large girl with a warm heart, who also has an unbelievable voice. She wants to become a pop-singer, but because she is unattractive, she’s only given opportunities to ghost-sing for a popular singer named Amy. Han-na is also in love with Amy’s producer, Sang-joon, but Sang-joon doesn’t notice her. One day, Han-Na is invited to Sang-Joon’s birthday party and receives a red dress from him to wear to his party. But at the party when she runs into Amy in the same red dress, Han-na is embarrassed with herself and disappears. 1 year later, Han-na returns as the beautiful Jenny.

programme.title: The Unrighteous [English Sub]
programme.desc: A realistic horror film about a young man trying to protect his family from his neighbors after illegal flyers are distributed in an old villa in the suburbs, leading to a sense of unease.

programme.title: IP MAN 3 [English Dub]
programme.desc: When a band of brutal gangsters led by a crooked property developer make a play to take over the city, Master Ip is forced to take a stand.
